entity: US HOLC-graded (redlined) neighborhoods, density of polluting industrial plants by grade
what_we_add: TRI plant density by grade (D 13.35, C 5.82, B 2.21, A 0.07 per 100 km2), the 6x D-vs-B ratio, D denser than B in 119 of 212 cities
why: Lane et al. (national HOLC areas) find industrial sources nearby rise from A to D; NPR says redlined areas drew more hazardous facilities: same finding in words. Estien et al. find no significant toxic-release gap, but in 8 cities on a different indicator and with no opposite direction, so no contradiction; our own 119 of 212 split fits it.
